embeds.title: Venice Setup Guide
embeds.description: Install, connect, tune — then the three problems people actually hit. Long answers live in `/setup` and `/faq`.

fields.name: 1 • Install and unlock
fields.value: Download the signed installer from <#1549499799861067876> and launch Venice. Open [zaeorion.com/connect](https://zaeorion.com/connect), sign in with the **same Discord account** you use here, and enter the one-time code in the launcher. There is no licence key, and your Discord ID alone is not a code.

fields.name: 2 • Connect video
fields.value: Use a **60 Hz capture card**, or **PS5 Remote Play**. Confirm the full game frame is visible in the Live Capture panel before you shoot. PS5 only — Xbox is not supported yet.

fields.name: 3 • Tune Shot Lead
fields.value: Tune Shot Lead against NBA 2K27's **TIMING** banner. One small step at a time, and keep the setup consistent between sessions.

fields.name: 🎥 Capture card not detected
fields.value: Close every other app using the card (OBS, browser tabs, the card's own viewer) — cards allow **one** at a time. Use a **USB 3.0+** port and check HDMI goes console → card **IN**. **Turn HDCP off** on the PS5: Settings → System → HDMI. That is the most common cause of a black or missing feed. Then check the driver in Device Manager, and try 1080p output.

fields.name: 🎮 Remote Play won't pair, or lags
fields.value: PS5: Settings → System → **Remote Play on**, and enable the rest-mode network options. Take a fresh PIN from Link Device — they expire quickly — and pair on the same network. For lag: **wire both ends**. Wi-Fi jitter cannot be timed through, and dropping the stream one quality notch beats a stuttering 1080p.

fields.name: 🟩 No greens / the overlay isn't reading
fields.value: Check the Live Capture panel actually shows gameplay — if it is black, fix that first. **Hold** the shot input and let Venice release it; releasing manually fights the tool. The controller must be plugged into the **PC**. Shot meter **on**, style **Arrow2** (White), in 2K's settings. Give it 10–15 practice shots to calibrate before judging it.

fields.name: 💻 Moving to another PC
fields.value: Access is locked to one PC. Run `/hwid_reset`: the first **3 resets are free**, after that each reset takes one day off your subscription. Then connect again on the new machine.

fields.name: Still stuck?
fields.value: `/status` shows what is linked to your account; `/setup` and `/faq` have the long answers. Anything else, open a ticket in <#1549499767321534464> — never post a one-time code, password or payment details in a public channel.
